Explore millions of stays, unforgettable attractions and find the ideal rental car for your next getaway, directly with Booking.com on ChatGPT.

positive.expected_behavior: A list of up to 10 attractions results with availability for the specified dates. Widget header shows the date range. Each card shows name, rating, price, duration, and a "View on Booking.com" button.

positive.prompt: Search for things to do in Barcelona for food enthusiast
positive.expected_behavior: A list of up to 10 attractions results filtered to the food_drinks category. Each card shows name, rating, price, duration, and a "View on Booking.com" button.

positive.prompt: Search for top-rated activities in Tokyo with at least 4.5 stars
positive.expected_behavior: A list of up to 10 attractions results filtered by minimum review score of 4.5. Each card shows high ratings and a "View on Booking.com" button.
